intuition.title: Controlled oversaturation builds whole colloidal crystals
intuition.text: A toluene nanocrystal dispersion is layered with 2-propanol and methanol. After about 2–3 weeks the source obtains facetted 10–20 µm colloidal crystals. Those dimensions describe whole assemblies, not the constituent nanocrystal diameter; the exact building-block size is unassigned.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
